french.la: Le lanceur se recouvre entièrement d'eau avant de charger sa cible. Blesse aussi le lanceur, mais avance sa position dans l'ordre d'action.
french.sv: Le lanceur se recouvre entièrement d'eau avant de charger sa cible. Cela blesse aussi gravement le lanceur.

english.la: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.
english.sv: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
